commit.message: feat(control): add secure SADHANA mobile operator ingress

interface_mismatches: The supervisor owns canonical campaign mutation while the phone ingress must not import TaskBoard, RuntimeStateStore, Mission Control stores, providers, tools, or systemctl; integration therefore crosses only typed callbacks and filesystem request candidates.

Tailscale Serve injects authenticated login identity into the filesystem Next bridge, which forwards only the exact login, Origin, Content-Type, and campaign-bound CSRF headers; the loopback ingress independently compares the login to its single-login credential and requires the server-injected bearer.

Emergency stop must reach a distinct root-watched dropbox whose release-owned path unit validates and stops the supervisor before any ordinary reconciliation; this slice supplies only signing, validation, and atomic publication.

Approve/reject cannot be safely represented by the six-field operational request without an accepted exact proposal digest, requested-effect, and warrant binding; this slice returns a typed unsupported response and writes no candidate for those actions.

The implementation is subordinate to sealed operator-control semantics SHA-256 69a0eb088277882e333ac41a6fb7014f6ed9d792e6d4a4b2b8510f20de15077c, HTTP binding SHA-256 9e1aec44c75cf6b24341389b8227f57fe4d4cf48328992f2125bffca34fcf3eb, and ACTIVE authority binding SHA-256 495f16964248948c68f97b5ec02b7e5d3e00e006979bf283ea783127e303d52d; the superseded preintegration authority digest is forbidden.
honest_blockers: This slice does not provision Tailscale Serve, systemd credentials, filesystem groups, path units, a VPS, DNS, TLS, or any remote host.

An accepted HTTP request proves only that one authenticated canonical candidate was durably published to an inbox; it does not prove supervisor application, proposal decision, effect execution, model work, semantic acceptance, or emergency-stop completion.
The normal same-process adapter delegates every authoritative mutation and idempotency lookup to injected callbacks and never opens canonical SQLite or imports TaskBoard/runtime owners.
The emergency-stop protocol is intentionally transport-distinct; release integration must preserve root validation and stop-first ordering before reporting an applied stop.
Approve/reject remain explicitly unavailable until an authority-owned canonical proposal/effect/warrant request shape is accepted and separately admitted.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this additive module, loopback ingress, isolated dashboard route/component/library, focused tests, integration reference, and packet. Remove any locally configured route to the endpoint before rollback. No database migration, deployment, remote mutation, systemd unit, provider action, proposal decision, or external publication is introduced by this commit.
